messages.text:
BL-845 — "hey bubble" spotted entirely on the device — passive listening makes no bridge turn and no cloud speech call, and the bubble goes soft teal to show it is armed without looking like a hot mic
What it solves: The overlay was already resized for this family of work: `96dp` -> `72dp`,
icon `52dp` -> `39dp` in `overlay_bubble.xml` (human asked for ~25% smaller,
applied 2026-07-30). No further sizing work here.
Approval context: Four of the intake's open design questions are answered here rather than asked. All are cheap to change now.
1. WAKE VARIANTS: "hey bubble" only in v1. The human named that phrase; adding "hi bubble" and accent-robustness tuning is a tuning pass once there is a real spotter to tune, not a first-sli…
BL-845 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-845" (or "reject BL-845 <reason>") to act.
